_comment: Which agents the bus can run, and how to invoke each one.
START HERE: copy this file to runners.json beside it and fill in your own
models. git ignores runners.json — which models a machine has is its owner's
business, so the bus ships no one's list and no model is built into the code.
`node tools/agent-bus/server.mjs discover` finds the model servers on this
machine and prints ready-to-paste (disabled) entries.
THE HUB CAN ONLY RUN WHAT IS LISTED THERE. The web form picks an id from the
file; it never sends a command. That is deliberate — a form that could pass a
shell string to a worker on your machine is a remote-code-execution hole with a
text box in front of it, even on loopback. Adding a runner is editing the file.
default — the runner id `work` uses when none is given (AGENT_BUS_RUNNER
overrides it). Without one, the first enabled runner.
type 'ollama' — POSTed to /api/generate. Nothing to install beyond the model.
An ollama cloud model answers the same way under its :cloud name. A cloud
runner sends its tasks' prompts off-machine: that is your choice to make.
type 'openai' — POSTed to <baseUrl>/chat/completions, the OpenAI-compatible
dialect LM Studio, llama.cpp server, vLLM and text-generation-webui all speak.
baseUrl is LOOPBACK-ONLY — a runner entry is the boundary of what a task can
reach, and that boundary is this machine.
type 'shell'  — spawned with the prompt written to STDIN. args are passed as a
list, never joined into a string, so nothing in a prompt can be read as an
argument or a second command.
thinking: true for a model that reasons before answering — it needs a bigger
predict budget, or the answer comes back empty with the reasoning stranded.
predict is the output budget and ctx the context window, both in tokens.
Every entry below ships disabled: set enabled to true once model is real.

runners.label: example-ollama — replace the model
runners.note: A model you have pulled: `ollama list` shows the names.

runners.label: example-openai — a local OpenAI-compatible server
runners.note: Loopback only. `server.mjs discover` fills in the port and the model.

runners.label: example-shell — a command-line agent
runners.note: Receives the prompt on stdin; its stdout is the answer.
